newsitem.title: USA: Ohio governor signs fiscal watch bill for colleges.
newsitem.headline: Ohio governor signs fiscal watch bill for colleges.

text.p: Ohio Gov. George Voinovich on Friday signed into law a bill that creates a fiscal watch system for state colleges and universities.

The law, which grew out of a financial crisis at Central State University last year, directs the Ohio Office of Budget and Management, in conjunction with the Ohio Board of Regents, the state auditor and representatives of two state schools, to develop triggers for a fiscal watch.

Those triggers include a requirment for timely quarterly reports from the schools, as well as a year-end financial statement, according to an analysis of the bill by the legislative service commission.
The board of regents will in turn use the triggers to declare a college or university under a fiscal watch.
Once a fiscal watch is declared, the law authorizes the governor to transfer the power and duties of a school's governing board to a temporary conservator and governance authority.
